evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing or agenda question — this is a follow-up call finalizing an out-of-state (San Antonio to Missouri City) estimate that was already emailed earlier.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No move-related concern was raised — only clarifying pricing questions (weekday vs. weekend rate, whether the total includes the trip/overnight fee) — scored N/A/full-credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'time based, so it all depends on how well prepared you are, you only pay for the actual time' — partial 'estimate is a window' credit; no rate-lock/100k line, no explicit beats-it-pay-less statement, no self-prep tip, no fairness check.

top_strength: Clearly worked through multiple date/day-of-week pricing scenarios (Friday vs. Sunday rates, with/without overnight fee) so the customer could make an informed date decision, and closed cleanly with a locked date.
coaching_note: While the customer was on hold for the estimate build, the rep filled the dead air with several minutes of rambling, off-script commentary instead of hold music or silence — unprofessional and worth flagging directly; separately, damage coverage and Meet Your Mover were never mentioned anywhere in this call.
